contact.hostDescription: Get to know Elena Philippou, your host at Villa Olivia Clara
contact.hostTitle: Your Host at Villa Olivia Clara
contact.welcomeMessage: I am delighted to welcome you to the island that has been my family's home for generations- since the 1800s! Although I only used to spend my summers here, I have now moved in permanently. I originally built Villa Olivia Clara to be my family's summer home, so it brings me immense joy to share this special place with you.
contact.cultureMessage: The Cycladic culture, the picturesque natural beauty and the hospitable people of this island are what drew me in. Life flows slowly here on Sifnos- you can take a moment to relax and listen to the waves.
contact.signature: I can't wait to see you there. - Elena
